column1: # en — SHAPE CORPUS for the normalizer's text→words axis. Read by en-shape-equivalence.mts.
# ⚠ SYNTHETIC AND GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION. Every line here is invented to exercise a SHAPE — a
# measurement with a unit, a range, an enumerated list, an alphanumeric code — and carries no real
# content of any kind. The shapes come from the defects reported at #1421–#1437.
#   eq        — `a` and `b` are two spellings of the SAME thing and MUST normalize identically.
#              ⚠ `a` IS ALWAYS THE ASCII SPELLING, deliberately: the Unicode one is what gets noticed
#              and fixed, so the ASCII one is where the unfixed defect lives, and it is what real
#   survive   — `b` is a regex that must NOT match the normalized output of `a`.
# === SYMBOLS THAT MUST NOT REACH THE WORD LAYER ===
